description.default: SiPage turns one SiYuan tab into a card desk — a browser-tab-like page holding 16 live cards (calendar, clock, weather, daily note, agenda, doc stats and more); drag freely, tidy in one click, embed into documents
description.en: SiPage turns one SiYuan tab into a card desk — a browser-tab-like page holding 16 live cards (calendar, clock, weather, daily note, agenda, doc stats and more); drag freely, tidy in one click, embed into documents
description.zh-CN: 思页：把思源的一个页签变成一屏卡片桌面——像浏览器标签页那样装得下日历 / 时钟 / 天气 / 日记 / 日程 / 统计等 16 张活卡片，可自由拖拽、一键整理，也能插进文档
